name: zajno-motion
description: Eight motion-design principles from Zajno Digital Studio (motion.zajno.com), codified as a reusable skill with production-ready GSAP / Lenis / Lottie / ScrollTrigger snippets and Zajno's actual custom-bezier easing curves.
license: MIT (skill structure) — principles attributable to Zajno

verifiedAssets: Empirical color palette, easing distribution, and duration histogram

changes: Source archive: refresh.sh now saves index.html + script.v33.min.js to ~/.cache/zajno-motion/source/ each run — full time-capsule if site is ever taken down
Takedown detection: if motion.zajno.com returns non-200 or empty, cache stays untouched and ~/.cache/zajno-motion/takedown-detected.md is written for Claude to surface
SKILL.md activation flow updated: check both last-diff.md AND takedown-detected.md
Moved Lottie raw files from skill folder to ~/.cache/zajno-motion/lotties/ — skill is now 152KB (was 1.5MB)
Added scripts/refresh.sh — fetch motion.zajno.com, diff against manifest, re-parse, write diff log
Added scripts/install-cron.sh + com.zajno-motion-refresh.plist — quarterly launchd job
Added cache manifest.json with sha256 hashes for change detection
Fixed case-collision bug in URL→filename mapping (APFS case-insensitivity)
SKILL.md now instructs Claude to check ~/.cache/zajno-motion/last-diff.md on activation and record material changes to memory
Idempotent refresh: zero false-positive change detections on no-op runs
Added assets/lotties/ — 27 original Lottie .json files
Added assets/parse_lotties.py — parser that extracts colors/eases/durations
Added references/zajno-empirical-data.md — stats from 7,897 keyframes
Updated SKILL.md and README.md to reference empirical data
Initial release
